title: Darkfire Shortbow

sources.title: Haste
markers: | summary = It allows spellcasters to allow their allies to become {{SmCond|Hastened}}.

summary: A +2 shortbow granting Fire and Cold resistance and a once-per-Long-Rest casting of Haste.

fields.Haste: Action. Target yourself or an ally within 30 ft. With Concentration, for up to 10 turns grant +2 AC, advantage on Dexterity saves, double movement speed, and one additional action each turn. The target becomes Lethargic when it ends.
fields.Base value: 480 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
